create_TETA_metric: create a TETA metric instance for evaluating track accuracy with configurable exhaustive mode
run_eval_sequence: run TETA metric evaluation on a single tracking sequence across all IoU thresholds
compute_global_alignment_score: compute global alignment score between ground truth and predicted track IDs
combine_sequences: combine TETA metric results across multiple evaluation sequences into aggregated scores
compute_matches: compute optimal ground-truth to track matches using Hungarian algorithm at each IoU threshold
